id: title:Gilbert09:retry a connection reset mid response body

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient network error handling and regression tests for Instagram warehouse ingestion, treating ChunkedEncodingError as a retryable condition.
review.reason: Adds ChunkedEncodingError to the retry exception tuple and provides a corresponding test, establishing bounded reliability and correctness for Instagram warehouse ingestion.
review.uncertainty: ChunkedEncodingError is a transient network error, but its actual production frequency and recovery benefit are unverified; the chunk lacks the full implementation and broader context of the Instagram client, so the systemic benefit is not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new exception handling or the full context of the Instagram client, so while the retry behavior and test are described, the actual benefit and implementation are not fully demonstrated. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds requests.exceptions.ChunkedEncodingError to the retry exception tuple, alongside existing InstagramRetryableError, requests.ReadTimeout, and requests.ConnectionError.
observations.posthog_connection: Retries Instagram warehouse ingestion requests when a chunked encoding error occurs, treating it as a transient network blip similar to connection resets, rather than failing immediately.

observations.behavior: Adds the requests library import to the test file, and a new test function that mocks a ChunkedEncodingError followed by a successful response, asserting the client retries and returns the expected body.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a test case to verify that the Instagram warehouse ingestion client correctly retries requests when encountering a ChunkedEncodingError, ensuring reliability of data ingestion.
